def factor_range_persistence_vol_phase_pos(df):
    """Range persistence with volatility phase gate, positive direction for payoff improvement."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    range_lag = range_ratio.shift(1)
    persistence = range_ratio.rolling(60, min_periods=60).corr(range_lag)

    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    atr_short = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=14), index=close.index)
    atr_long = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=60), index=close.index)
    vol_phase = (atr_long / atr_short.replace(0.0, np.nan)) - 1.0
    weight = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.tanh(vol_phase)

    factor = persistence * weight
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_range_persistence_vol_phase_pos"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_persistence_vol_phase_pos"]
